doc: A good-looking chart where costs make the exit impossible: net execution veto, never sized by the forecast.

assertions.assert: control: the clean fixture token's FORECAST number is shown (FORMAT-ONLY)
the token whose exit is impossible (CANNOT_EXIT_5K) has its FORECAST number withheld
the report says the forecast is overridden by risk
a 30% exit loss gives a size cap of 0 and no size from the forecast
a barrier touch by a tiny candle is flagged WICK_TOUCH (not a fill)
